Name: ✦ Infestation
Description: <light_purple>Break the wrong block and three more of it come pouring out.
- A <red><bold>Life</bold> <reset>pool that reflects the swarm, not the individual
- <green><bold>Pickup</bold> <reset>reach for the rubble it leaves behind
- <green><bold>Mining</bold> <reset>through stone the way it always has

Notifications.20: <light_purple>The wall cracks, and more of it pours out — Infestation spreads.
